title: Checkers Classic
description: Classic English checkers (American draughts) on a wooden board. Capture is mandatory, jumps chain, and kings fly both ways. Play the computer at four difficulty levels or pass the phone to a friend.
instructions: Tap a piece, then tap a highlighted square (or drag it there). If a capture is available you must take it, and keep jumping with the same piece until the chain ends. Black moves first.
